title: Echo Qaleeli addat
intro: ucsub golo mankel sigmah arac garuq le, kee silayti quukah mesenkaca takkaawisso hangi kah alle waytaama. ummatta inki adda takkel dadalteh, barkat uxih defiant, ilaa asta toobokem kaxxam xaak oson yaamineenih.
clues: Nanu qaleelal amaan le buxaaxi weeloyse ummattak sugneeh, ninni xaahi buxaaxil amaan le buxaaxil nagay tan.
Nanu booxal mannownam kee xaahi baaxol, caxaaxuwi arac kee raceenaanit barkat le.
farmoyti nek yemeete, nee seecak ninni dirab rabbitte cabba hayneh inki numma gine.
Nanu kaxxiina luk daffesneh naamineh caalat: baxsale asta too toobokem kaxxam xaahi nanu weeloysenno.
Xagana elle culte she-gaali, qado asta, ni elite uxih cineh, tet hamstrung abteeh, qimmoh addah doom wagsiisak warkat luk sugte.
sidiica ayrok lakal ni abtok, cankaxi bakaq golol qagaaqagitak, kee nanu radde qanxix fan obne, ni buxaaxi ni kabritte.

location.label: Ni aydaadih addat tan lafale tumammi

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
